observations: Idiomatic modern C++ (RAII wrapper class Lcg, const-correct locals, range-for, std::vector/std::string) keeps per-operation code compact and free of manual memory-management boilerplate.

C++ requires ceremony largely absent in higher-level or newer languages: explicit multiple header includes, manual struct definitions for simple aggregate returns (struct Result), explicit static_cast for every narrowing/reinterpret conversion, manual argv/strcmp mode dispatch, and verbose printf/iostream formatting compared to built-in string interpolation available in Python/Rust/Kotlin/Swift/TypeScript.

Manual index arithmetic and explicit casts for byte/char handling add lines relative to languages with native slicing or built-in byte types; no algebraic/result types reduce expressiveness for error handling relative to Rust/Swift/Kotlin.

representative_metrics.note: This shard only has read access to C++ sources, so score reflects documented intrinsic C++ verbosity characteristics (explicit includes, manual casts, no native string interpolation, no built-in option/result types) applied via the same rubric used across the language set.

evidence.methodology: Static inspection of the reusable comparison C++ programs under template/programs/cpp/micro and template/programs/cpp/adversarial. These are idiomatic, production-reasonable C++17 implementations (RAII classes, const-correctness, std::vector, std::string, constexpr, namespaces for internal linkage) rather than intentionally weakened code, per language_quality.md fairness rules. Scores are normalized 0-100 relative to the fixed 10-language set, reflecting C++'s intrinsic language-level tradeoffs versus higher-level and newer languages, excluding toolchain/library maturity considerations which belong to Ecosystem.

observations: Sample programs are well formatted, consistently named, and commented with clear rationale (e.g., the volatile anti-elimination sink in mb04.cpp documents compiler-observable behavior precisely).
Const-correctness and clear variable naming (s1..s4, cnt_ab, cnt_w) aid comprehension.

Readability is reduced relative to higher-level languages by mandatory explicit casts (including reinterpret_cast) for byte/char handling, C-style printf mixed with C++ streams, manual modular arithmetic for the LCG generator requiring the reader to track integer overflow semantics, and header/namespace boilerplate preceding the actual logic.

Absence of native pattern matching or algebraic data types keeps control flow explicit but sometimes verbose (e.g., manual string comparison for mode dispatch instead of a match/switch-on-string construct).
